programmes.d: A Texas father takes his spoiled teenage daughter to an exclusive Caribbean resort and somehow ends up packed in his own suitcase.
A homicidal vegan gelato maker gets her just desserts after two bodies are found in her freezer.
The head of a family-run maple syrup business disappears, and a psychic claims she's buried somewhere in the sugar shack.
A plastic surgeon's wife disappears, and police eventually uncover a body behind a video arcade and a Tickle Trunk worthy of blackmail and murder.
When an animal-loving loner fails to show up for Christmas dinner, detectives find the man dead in his trailer, alongside the feathery corpse of his lovebird and BFF.
When the body of a soap opera star is found behind a dumpster in Los Angeles, detectives unravel a sordid plot.
Investigators suspect two grannies are behind a twisted insurance scam, but they have to find the evidence that ties them to a hit-and-run.
A Miami cocktail waitress tells her scandalous truth on a tell-all game show and ends up dead.
When a Mexican millionaire disappears, a shrewd undercover cop gets the perp to cough up the murder weapon.
At the Paris Opera House, an infatuated stagehand takes on the murderous role of the villain.
A Texas rodeo star is devastated when he comes home to find his beauty-queen wife dead with multiple rattlesnake bites on her feet.
When her husband threatens her with divorce, an Arkansas hunter sets the scene for a tragic accident that's actually a murder.
A ballet dancer is bludgeoned to death with her own point shoes, and investigators find a bookish body double waiting in the wings.
When a rotting corpse is discovered in the trunk of a car, detectives uncover a sordid plot that includes a nouveau riche computer geek and a pair of seasoned golddiggers.

programmes.t: Bizarre Murders: All Brawn, No Brains
programmes.d: Looking to make a quick buck, two crooked trainers kidnap and kill their wealthy client. And though he survives to tell the tale, police dismiss his outrageous story.
Envy rears its ugly head in the sordid tale of a successful geek and two down-on-their-luck jocks.
Claiming to be possessed by the spinster spirit of a murdered woman she barely knew, a New Orleans nurse leads cops straight to the killer.
A two-timing German cheesemaker is poisoned by bratwurst, and the dead man's girlfriend immediately points to the 'other woman'.
Dead women and mutilated mannequins pop up in a Texas town. And it will take a broken window, a pizza box, and a few stray hairs to track down a homicidal postman.

programmes.t: Bizarre Murders: It's a Lying Shame
programmes.d: A privileged prep school kid will do anything to live on easy street, and when his father forces him to come clean, dad's ultimatum proves deadly.
Targeted by an obsessed cyber-stalker, a womanizing basketball star's fiancée is gunned down in his home.
When a doomsday survivalist is shot dead in his bunker, his daughter and son-in-law incriminate themselves with a story about masked intruders and the power of prayer.
A cupcake-baking homemaker gets away with murder. That is, until she tries it on husband number two.
Determined to unleash his creative genius, a tortured San Francisco artist obsessed with his muse ends up killing the wrong girl.
A small town diner is robbed, and the owner murdered. There's only one witness, and just because it's a bird, doesn't mean it's not talking.
A small town celebrity goes missing, just as body parts start tuning up around town.
It was September in Biloxi and summer's heat was just beginning to fade when a killer entered the home of attorney Vince Sherry and his politically active wife, Margaret.
The deaths of a string of champion racehorses may be linked to the death of candy heiress Helen Vorhees Brach.
Police investigate the bomb that blew apart the car of Mark Hoffmann, a highly respected and religious Mormon. Narrated by Paul Winfield.
In the early morning of March 7, 1986, multi-millionaire Stan Cohen was shot three times in the head with his own gun as he slept in his Miami mansion.
A woman's naked body is found outside a Seattle nightclub, posed demurely with a pinecone in her hand. Narrated by Paul Winfield.
In an instant it was over. 49-year-old Larry Volk was shot in the head as he fixed his car in the hot Nevada sun.
Who hired the hitman that killed Alice McArthur in Little Rock, Arkansas in 1982? Was it her criminal defense attorney husband or his mistress Mary Lee Orsini?
In 1994, Kim Groves was gunned down in front of her home. Notorious for its crime, New Orleans had just found another victim.
Late one January night in 1991, Richard Lyon rushed his wife Nancy to a Dallas hospital. Within a few days, her flu-like symptoms turned into life-threatening agony and she died.
Here's a scandal-filled saga about sex, money, and hypocrisy. It's the tale of Kathy Willet, a housewife turned prostitute and one of her customers.
